Data navigation tree
Detailed datasets
contains all data publicly available from Eurostat. They are presented in so-called multi-dimensional datasets.
Selected datasets
offers a selection of Eurostat data offering less indicators and variables than the detailed datasets. Data are presented in 2 or 3 dimensional tables.
Both branches are organised according to 9 statistical themes.
EU policies
presents datasets organised according to specific EU policies.
Cross-cutting
offers a selection of statistical topics that are obtained from different data sources and collections.
All datasets can be customised and downloaded in different formats.
Updates
Data in the data navigation tree are updated twice a day at
11:00
and
23:00
, Central European Time (CET).
Legends
Icons
Icon
Explanation
Data browser
is the tool for displaying, visualising, and downloading data. It allows you to adapt the dataset to your needs by filtering dimensions, creating customised views, saving bookmarks, and making use of the different download formats. For more details, please consult the
online help of the data browser
.
Dataset compression
is used to download complete datasets in tabular separate value format (tsv).
Metadata
offer explanatory texts and summary information about the statistical indicators or data collections.
COMEXT database
includes data on international trade and production of goods.
Dictionaries / code lists
Complete code lists can be found in the bulk download under the tab
code lists
.
Flags
Flags are codes added to the data and defining a specific characteristic.
As from 27 January 2025, flags will be dispatched in 2 code lists
: Obs_status (observation status) and Conf_status (confidentiality status). This change will further align the flags with the SDMX usage of flags.
Observation status
The observation status list '
Obs_status
' will contain the following flags:

Definition

definition differs (see metadata)
e
estimated

Confidentiality status
The confidentiality status list '
Conf_status
' will contain the following flags:
Conf_status code
Definition
C
confidential
N
not for publication
P
information under non-statistical secrecy arrangements
The flags N (not for publication) and P (information under non-statistical secrecy arrangements) are newly introduced flag codes.
Change of previous codes
The previously existing codes of the following 3 flags have been changed:
Previous flag
New flag
s (Eurostat estimate)
i (value imputed by Eurostat or other receiving agencies)
z (not applicable)
m (missing value, data cannot exist)
c (confidential)
C (confidential) - but moved to the new 'Conf_status' code list
